correctness.rationale: For m>=2 orthogonal products of m nondegenerate planar triangles containing the centered unit disk, each factor has area>=3sqrt3 and perimeter>=6sqrt3 with rigid equilateral equality by Jensen on half angles; f0=3. Face-volume generating polynomial is exactly product(A_i+L_i t+3t²). Positivity yields every coefficient lower bound [t^k](3sqrt3+6sqrt3 t+3t²)^m; equality rigid for k<2m and automatic at vertex count k=2m. Factor H(t)=3sqrt3(1+u t)(1+v t), u/v distinct with mean 1, and strict Newton inequalities show R_m(0)=R_m(1)>R_m(2)>...>R_m(2m); endpoints straddle 1, so a single integer crossing cutoff K_m. Correct boundary m=2 K=2; exact symbolic coefficient calculation independently checks m=2..8; does not assert all admissible polytopes.
